assessment.goal_feasibility: feasible with ~500 kcal daily deficit and 5 weekly sessions

adjustment_criteria: If weight loss <1 lb/week, reduce calories 100 kcal

transformation_roadmap.objective: Lose additional 5 lb, improve cardio endurance
adjustment_criteria: If fatigue rises, add active‑recovery day
If weight stalls >2 weeks, review calorie accuracy

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.progression_rule: Add 5 lb when 12 reps completed comfortably

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.progression_rule: Add 5 lb per dumbbell when 12 reps achievable

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull bar to chest, shoulder blades together
exercises.progression_rule: Increase weight 5 lb when 15 reps possible

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.progression_rule: Add 2.5 lb per hand when 12 reps smooth

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Maintain straight line, elbows under shoulders

cool_down: Static stretch major muscles 30 s each

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Press up, elbows slightly below shoulder level
exercises.progression_rule: Add 5 lb per hand when 12 reps easy

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Pull handle to torso, squeeze shoulder blades
exercises.progression_rule: Increase weight 5 lb when 15 reps possible

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.progression_rule: Add 2.5 lb per hand when 20 reps possible

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
instructions: Extend elbows, keep upper arms static

cool_down: Chest and shoulder stretch 30 s each

exercises.name: Bike Sprint Intervals
exercises.progression_rule: Add 1 interval per week up to 12

exercises.name: Yoga Flow (Sun Salutation)
exercises.progression_rule: Increase hold time by 5 s each week

progression_rules.condition: Complete prescribed reps with proper form for 2 consecutive sessions
progression_rules.action: Increase load by 5 lb (upper body) or 10 lb (lower body)
progression_rules.safety_limit: Do not increase more than twice per month per exercise
